rules:
👻 *Ghost Hunt — Halloween*

Ghosts appear randomly (every 5–30 min). When one shows up, send *!catch* before it vanishes in 20 seconds!

🎲 *Rarities:*
👻 Common — 1 point
🕷️ Uncommon — 2 points
🦇 Rare — 3 points
💀 Epic — 5 points
🎃 Legendary — 10 points

📊 Points are shared across the community (if linked).

*Commands:*
`{{prefix}}ghosthunt`
- rules and status

`{{prefix}}ghosthunt ranking`
- ranking

`{{prefix}}catch`
- catch the ghost when it appears

`{{prefix}}ghosthunt status @user`
- check your or someone's stats

`{{prefix}}ghosthunt reset`
- reset your own stats

`{{prefix}}ghosthunt activate`
- enable the game _(admin)_

`{{prefix}}ghosthunt deactivate`
- disable the game _(admin)_

📌 *Status:* {{active}}

{{emoji}} *{{rarity}}* — +{{pts}} {{pts, plural, one{point} other{points}}} _(total: {{total}})_
